tenses.name: Simple Present

uses.example: I go to work every day.
The sun rises in the east.

uses.es: Horarios o eventos programados en el futuro

keys: Se usa con adverbios de frecuencia: always, usually, sometimes, never, every day, on Mondays, once a week, etc.
En tercera persona (he, she, it), se agrega -s o -es al verbo.
Para negativos e interrogativos, se usa do/does.

interrogative.example: Does she work in an office?

tenses.name: Present Continuous

uses.es: Acciones que están ocurriendo en el momento
uses.example: I am reading a book now.
She is staying in a hotel this week.
We are traveling to Spain next summer.

keys: Se usa con expresiones como: now, at the moment, right now, today, this week, currently, etc.
Se forma con el verbo to be + verbo en -ing.
No se usa con verbos de estado (like, love, want, know, need, believe, etc.).

negative.example: They are not listening to music.

interrogative.example: Is she studying for the test?

tenses.name: Simple Past

uses.example: I visited my grandmother last weekend.

uses.es: Eventos o hechos pasados sin relación con el presente
uses.example: He lived in Paris for five years.

uses.es: Secuencias de eventos en el pasado
uses.example: She woke up, had breakfast, and left for work.

keys: Se usa con expresiones como: yesterday, last week, last year, in 2020, two days ago, when I was a child, etc.
Verbos regulares terminan en -ed (worked, played, studied).
Verbos irregulares cambian su forma (go → went, eat → ate, see → saw).
Para negativos e interrogativos, se usa did + verbo base.

tenses.name: Future Simple – Will

uses.example: I'm hungry! I will order a pizza.
I will help you with your homework.

keys: Se usa con expresiones como: tomorrow, next week, next year, in the future, one day, I think, probably, etc.
La estructura es will + verbo base para todos los sujetos.

tenses.name: Be going to + Infinitive

uses.example: I'm going to visit my parents next weekend.
Look at those clouds! It's going to rain!

keys: Se usa con expresiones como: tonight, next week, in two days, this year, soon, in the near future, etc.
Se forma con be (am/is/are) + going to + verbo base.

affirmative.pattern: I am going to + verbo base
affirmative.example: I am going to buy a new phone.

affirmative.pattern: He/She/It is going to + verbo base
affirmative.example: She is going to travel to Spain.

affirmative.pattern: We/You/They are going to + verbo base
affirmative.example: They are going to play soccer.

negative.pattern: I am not going to + verbo base
negative.example: I am not going to watch that movie.

negative.pattern: He/She/It is not going to + verbo base
negative.example: He is not going to study tonight.

negative.pattern: We/You/They are not going to + verbo base
negative.example: We are not going to be late.

interrogative.pattern: Am I going to + verbo base + ?
interrogative.example: Am I going to meet him later?

interrogative.pattern: Is He/She/It going to + verbo base + ?
interrogative.example: Is she going to cook dinner?

interrogative.pattern: Are We/You/They going to + verbo base + ?
interrogative.example: Are they going to travel next year?
